attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

attacks.name: Tone-Deaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Quick Turn
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Battle Tower
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card. Whenever any player plays any Pokémon from their hand to Level-Up 1 of their Pokémon, remove 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

cards.name: Champion's Room
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card. The Retreat cost for each Pokémon SP (both yours and your opponent's) is Colorless less.

cards.name: Cynthia's Guidance
cards.text: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the other cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Cyrus's Initiative
cards.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is heads, look at your opponent's hand. For each heads, choose 1 card from your opponent's hand and put it on the bottom of your opponent's deck in any order.

cards.name: Night Teleporter
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put all cards in your hand on top of your deck. Then, search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Palmer's Contribution
cards.text: Search your discard pile for up to 5 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

cards.name: Absol G LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Absol G. Absol G LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Darkness Send
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you put this Pokémon from your hand onto your Active Absol G, you may flip 3 coins. For each heads, put the top card from your opponent's deck in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Darkness Slugger
attacks.text: You may discard a card from your hand. If you do, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.name: Blaziken FB LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Blaziken FB. Blaziken FB LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Burning Spirit
abilities.text: Any damage done by attacks to a Burned Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) is increased by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). No more than 40 damage can be added by all Burning Spirit Poké-Bodies.

attacks.name: Jet Shoot
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Blaziken FB by attacks is increased by 40 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Electivire FB LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Electivire FB. Electivire FB LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Energy Recycle
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. If you do, your turn ends. Search your discard pile for up to 3 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. This power can't be used if Electivire FB is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Powerful Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Staraptor FB LV.X
cards.text: Put this card onto your Active Staraptor FB. Staraptor FB LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power or Poké-Body from its previous Level.

abilities.name: Fast Call
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Supporter card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can't be used if Staraptor FB is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Defog
attacks.text: Before doing damage, you may discard any Stadium card in play. If you do, this attack's base damage is 70 instead of 40.

abilities.name: Aqua Mirage
abilities.text: If you have no cards in your hand, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dwindling Wave
attacks.text: Does 80 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Deep Sea Pressure
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's Retreat Cost is ColorlessColorless more.

attacks.name: Aqua Wave
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Sonicboom
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

attacks.name: Baton Pass
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, move as many Energy cards attached to this Pokémon as you like to the new Active Pokémon.
